verdict.rationale: Reflect's own docs list native importers for Evernote (ENEX), Markdown files and Roam (JSON), plus Apple Notes and Workflowy, so three of the four named sources are covered. Notion is not listed, and nothing documents whether structure, links or attachments survive the import. missing for 10: Notion import, documented preservation of note structure/hierarchy, preservation of wiki-links/backlinks on import, attachment import, independent or hands-on corroboration of import fidelity.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my existing notes from Notion, Evernote, Roam, or plain Markdown with structure, links, and attachments preserved

citations.quote: We currently support imports from: Apple Notes (HTML) Evernote (ENEX) Markdown files Roam (JSON) Workflowy (OPML)
First you’ll have to export your existing Apple Notes using the provided script below, then import them into Reflect normally.
